purpose: Audit robustness and conditional uncertainty of the two-axis AusTraits measurement-aware L/A architecture without modifying the 158-system high-support core.

estimand.model: Gaussian crossed family and trait random intercepts with system-specific independent residual variance sigma2_system + v_i; REML; no reassignment of systems.
estimand.warning: L and A are two estimands sharing the same system variance, not statistically independent or orthogonal biological processes.

additional_robustness: cap measurement variances at within-axis 95th percentile
shrink each variance 50% toward median of its named trait
replace each variance with pooled global median

bootstrap.type: parametric conditional on the reference split-half variance v_i, fixed crossed family-trait observation graph and fitted Gaussian variance components
not_included: uncertainty in v_i from only three split replicates
covariance of rho errors among traits measured on overlapping species

hard_nonclaims: Do not call split-half-derived v_i an exact unbiased full-data variance.
Do not call conditional bootstrap fraction a p-value.
Do not claim a significant evolutionary mechanism or directionality.
The 158-system high-support subset is not the whole prospective 259-system AusTraits core.
Do not reclassify any pre-frozen prospective AusTraits decision.
